The '''Truuzdann system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained a world of the same name, [[Truuzdann]].
